**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2**

Section 2.2 makes Vendor Customer's "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — unlimited-duration exclusive dealing with no category scope limit and no performance-based exit, which is our walk-away position. It also directly contradicts Section 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment and may engage any supplier).

Other "exclusive" hits in the document are benign or favourable to us: § 13.1 (non-exclusive licence to Customer), §§ 19.4 / 21.4 / 30.2 (exclusive remedy mechanics), § 28.2 (exclusive jurisdiction). No requirements-purchase or "shall not procure from any third party" language elsewhere.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** delete Section 2.2 in full, with a comment offering the fallback (defined product category, 12 months, automatic termination on SLA/delivery failure) if Vendor pushes back.
